text: Counts comments in OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP) that contain at least one specific real-world example offered in the comment's own argument: an actual, concrete case such as a named or identifiable event, person, organization, policy, study, place, or the commenter's concrete personal experience (no outside verification needed). Invented or hypothetical scenarios, generic generalizations and vague references don't qualify; OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred never count as evidence, and generic delta/platform-rule discussion doesn't count unless itself a specific real-world case. Each comment counts at most once regardless of number of examples; counts comments, not distinct commenters. Output is an integer from 0 to list length; an empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null.
